title: Owner-gate scripts/release-status.mjs: deploy.sh's deploy-alone guard depends on it, but owner-gate's GATES does not cover it
acceptance: scripts/owner-gate.mjs counts scripts/release-status.mjs and scripts/release-status.test.mjs as CI / deploy / infrastructure, with cases in scripts/owner-gate.test.mjs, so a PR that weakens deploy.sh's deploy-alone guard or its tests needs owner-approved, like a change to deploy.sh itself.
nextAction: Agent-created (round 1124 web Lane 1, 2026-11-24): deploy.sh calls scripts/release-status.mjs --guard, but owner-gate's CI / deploy / infrastructure class does not match that file. Changing owner-gate classes was outside RF-244's brief. Backlog until the owner sets Ready; the change itself is owner-gated.

evidence.summary: The CI / deploy / infrastructure gate matches scripts/ files only by /^scripts\/(deploy|owner-gate|pr-gates|rf-trace|required-secrets|production-smoke)[^/]*$/, so owner-gate reports a change to scripts/release-status.mjs or its test as not owner-gated.
